summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest, 13/13 passed) and frontend (Playwright e2e) testing of FleetCare. Verified auth, vehicle CRUD, collaudo end-of-month math (2021-05-15 -> 2025-05-31, then 2025-09-20 -> 2027-09-30), circulation rules (bollo does NOT block circulation), insurance policy CRUD, suspend/reactivate flow, 304-day cap (returns 400 with 'Limite massimo di sospensione'), dashboard stats, and Excel/PDF report exports. UI login, KPIs, add vehicle, filters, search, export downloads, and delete-with-confirm all worked.

minor.issue: CORS allow_origins='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per browser spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Currently works because frontend uses Authorization bearer token, but httpOnly cookie approach will fail cross-origin. Recommend setting explicit CORS_ORIGINS.

issues: Radix Dialog warnings: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' on VehicleFormDialog and PolicyDialog - a11y issue, add DialogDescription.

action_items: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to VehicleFormDialog, PolicyDialog, CollaudoDialog to remove Radix a11y warnings.
Tighten CORS: replace '*' with explicit origin list in backend/.env if cookie-based auth is expected to work cross-origin.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: cookie set with samesite='none' + secure=True + wildcard CORS is inconsistent; browsers will refuse to send cookies cross-site under a wildcard origin.
Startup uses on_event (deprecated in FastAPI); consider lifespan handlers.
normalize_policy_suspension mutates policy in place while build_vehicle_view is called after; correct, but relies on caller updating DB — safe in current call sites but fragile.
seed_data_creation: Test used TEST_-prefixed vehicles; cleanup fixture deletes them after run. UI test created and then deleted ZT999XX.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs standalone with local mongo. 304-day cap test uses pymongo direct write to set cumulative_suspension_days=304 then hits /policy/suspend to expect 400. All core flows are green.
